a.text: I want to be upfront before we start. With an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs about three rounds, so we would both survive only about 4% of the time. I don't think I can follow it. I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we probably both fail, so plan accordingly. I won't take more than 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
